name: Cut The String
body:
School: enchantment (compulsion) [mind-affecting]; Level: jester 1

CASTING

Casting Time: 1 standard action

EFFECT

Range: Close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)

Target: One creature

Duration: 1 round per level

Saving Throw: Will negates; Spell Resistance: yes

DESCRIPTION

You cause the target to become unable to make opportunity attacks for the duration of the spell.
